contracts.promise: MCAP0 structural checks and available CRCs
contracts.conditions: Supported format and explicit budgets; zero CRC means unavailable
contracts.failure: Invalid data rejected; no inferred absent-checksum verification

contracts.promise: Selective queries do not claim full-file validation
contracts.conditions: Indexed query validates summary and accessed chunks; --full separately loads within budget
contracts.failure: Corruption outside selected regions may be detected only by full validation

contracts.promise: Reject ineffective CLI budgets before IO
contracts.conditions: Only options consumed by the chosen operation are accepted

contracts.promise: New-file publication has an explicit hard-link commit point
contracts.conditions: Same-directory hard links; exclusively owned staging path
contracts.failure: Before link: no target. After link: complete target can exist; cleanup failure reports output published

contracts.promise: Committed recording segments survive retry without rewriting
contracts.conditions: Owned directory, matching manifest/options, immutable committed segments
contracts.failure: Changed committed files fail closed; incomplete tail quarantined; no power-loss guarantee

contracts.promise: Historical documented formats remain readable within their identities
contracts.conditions: Frozen 0.17.1 MCAP0/MIDX1/MIDX2/MRSC1/ABAT1/MLIV1 fixtures; supported configuration unchanged
contracts.failure: Unsupported future version, source/plan mismatch rejected

contracts.promise: Recipe resume binds inputs, rules, code and runtime
contracts.conditions: Same recorded plan and intact completed artifacts
contracts.failure: Changed-code resume intentionally rejected; create a new job

contracts.promise: Failing writes do not falsely advance committed output
contracts.conditions: Write callback accepts all bytes or raises; host loops over short writes
contracts.failure: ENOSPC, zero progress, sync/close/link failures return errors; accepted is not committed

contracts.promise: Runtime claims are exercised on declared environments
contracts.conditions: Compiler 0.10.17 and separate current compiler; Linux/Windows; Node minimum 22.3 and maintained 22
contracts.failure: Unsupported combinations are not inferred from a passing matrix cell

contracts.promise: Published installation evidence belongs to the requested release
contracts.conditions: Fixed version, package SHA256, fresh consumer, no source override
contracts.failure: Wrong version/checksum/CI status or missing result prevents successful release verification
